# Best-confirmed sequences

*Generated by `refactored/report/best.py` after r012. This is a read-off: nothing reads it back, so it never steers what is asked. A **stretch** is a run of glyphs in which every link between neighbours was confirmed by real minds, reading in either direction: the longest context the minds were shown names the next glyph as its most-agreed continuation, with agreement ≥ 0.75 and from ≥ 2 LLM families. Seed votes help find candidates but never confirm a link. Stretches are ranked by length, then by mean agreement. The full tree, with branches and open ends, is in `SEQUENCES.md`.*

**85 confirmed stretches of 3+ glyphs** (by length: 3: 18, 4: 12, 5: 9, 6: 8, 7: 5, 8: 7, 9: 6, 10+: 20); **0 manifested cycles.**
